title: Regeneration docs switch to RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR env var, but the diff contains no code reading it
evidence:
-////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv
-////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative
-////    to the server package root.)
+////   RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=priv gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake
+////   (cwd = server/; RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv"
+////   relative to the server package root.)

+      case audit_report.generate(to_report_data(p), priv_dir, watermark: True) {
detail: The only pdf_prebake code hunks are the header comment, making to_report_data public, and the generate call. No hunk reads RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR, so the documented invocation contract and the code disagree.
recommended_fix: Either add the env-var lookup to main()/priv_dir in this diff, or revert the comment to the argv form actually implemented.

title: Cover page gets the watermark twice (or a permanently dead background setting)
evidence:
+// The cover page paints a full-bleed navy block OVER the page background,
+// so the cover also ends its block with `#demo-watermark` (place floats
+// above the flow). Interior pages get it via `set page(background: …)`.

   footer: none,
+  background: demo-watermark,
 )

+
+  #demo-watermark
 ]
detail: If the navy block truly covers the background, the cover's background: demo-watermark is unreachable dead config; if it doesn't (block is sized to the content area), the watermark stamps twice with different anchors.
recommended_fix: Pick one mechanism for the cover: drop the cover background line, or drop the explicit #demo-watermark and let the background carry it.

title: Watermark references DM Sans but the diff bundles no font assets
evidence:
+        text(
+          font: "DM Sans",
+          weight: 700,

 #set text(font: "Geist", size: 10pt, fill: charcoal, lang: "en", region: "ie")
detail: The watermark introduces a second font alongside Geist while the compile uses --ignore-system-fonts with only priv/typst-fonts. The diff adds no font binary; if DM Sans isn't already bundled, typst silently substitutes.
recommended_fix: Confirm DM Sans exists in priv/typst-fonts (or switch to Geist); assert the compile emits no missing-font warning.

title: Test-only normalize_metadata exported from the production FFI module
evidence:
--export([compile/3, available/0]).
+-export([compile/3, available/0, normalize_metadata/1]).

+%% version, template and payload. Used by the golden byte-identity pins in
+%% audit_report_test.gleam and pdf_prebake_test.gleam.

+@external(erlang, "ai@audit_report_ffi", "normalize_metadata")
detail: No production caller exists in the diff; only the two test files bind it, each re-declaring the same external. Test helper living in production code.
recommended_fix: Move normalize_metadata to a shared test-support module, or expose it via a public audit_report helper used by both tests.

title: Watermark pins assert only byte inequality, not per-page presence
evidence:
+// Every PDF produced in demo mode must carry the diagonal DEMO watermark.

+        normalize_metadata(marked)
+        |> should.not_equal(normalize_metadata(plain))
detail: marked != plain proves the watermark exists somewhere, not on every page. A regression dropping it from all but one page still passes, contradicting the stated invariant.
recommended_fix: Parse page count and count watermark text runs (or render pages to images and diff) so per-page presence is actually pinned.

title: Golden byte-identity pin is hostage to the typst version; nothing pins or normalizes it
evidence:
+%% trailer /ID pair). Everything else is deterministic for a given typst
+%% version, template and payload. Used by the golden byte-identity pins in
+%% audit_report_test.gleam and pdf_prebake_test.gleam.
detail: The comment itself concedes determinism holds only per typst version. Any typst upgrade in CI changes version-stamped bytes (e.g. CreatorTool) and fails the pin with no normalization for it.
recommended_fix: Pin the typst version in CI, or extend normalize_metadata to strip version-stamped metadata fields before the byte comparison.

title: --input watermark=true appended after the positional output path
evidence:
+        bit_array.from_string(template_path),
+        bit_array.from_string(output_path),
      ],
      watermark_args,
    )

+    True -> [
+      bit_array.from_string("--input"),
+      bit_array.from_string("watermark=true"),
+    ]
detail: The appended flag lands after output_path, relying on typst's parser accepting options after positionals. Works today; breaks silently if parsing tightens.
recommended_fix: Insert the watermark --input pair before template_path (e.g. list.append(options, [template, output])) so all options precede positionals.
